name: Securities Account Audit Trail Query V 01
definition: The SecuritiesAccountAuditTrailQuery message is sent by an instructing party to the executing party to query for the securities account audit trail recorded in the system.

MessageHeader.name: Message Header
MessageHeader.definition: Common business identification for the message.

SearchCriteria.name: Search Criteria
SearchCriteria.definition: Defines the criteria to be used to query the securities account audit trail by the executing system.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
